description: Source code for WebSocket route dispatcher in Playwright, managing WebSocket interactions, event handling, and communication between page or browser context and WebSocket mock source.

classes.name: WebSocketRouteDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class managing WebSocket route interactions, event handling, and communication with WebSocket mock source.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Sets up WebSocket route dispatcher, exposes binding, and injects mock WebSocket source script.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Removes WebSocket route dispatcher and disposes associated resources.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Handles connection request to WebSocket route.

methods.name: sendToPage
methods.description: Sends message to page via WebSocket.

methods.name: sendToServer
methods.description: Sends message to server via WebSocket.

methods.name: closePage
methods.description: Closes WebSocket connection from page side.

methods.name: closeServer
methods.description: Closes WebSocket connection from server side.

methods.name: _evaluateAPIRequest
methods.description: Internal method to evaluate API requests in the context of the frame.

methods.name: _onDispose
methods.description: Handles cleanup upon disposal of dispatcher.

methods.name: _executionContextGone
methods.description: Handles cleanup when execution context is gone, e.g., page closed or navigated.
